content: Individuals who are taking glucocorticoids should be evaluated for their risk of developing diabetes, as these medications can elevate blood glucose levels and contribute to the onset of the condition. Similarly, patients on statins should be monitored for potential diabetes risk, as these cholesterol-lowering drugs have been associated with an increased likelihood of developing diabetes in some individuals. Additionally, those using certain types of diuretics should undergo screening for diabetes, as these medications may also raise the risk of the disease.
